rows: This form was prepared by the Maintenance Procedures Development and Quality Control Sector of the Holding Company, and the agreement of the MPIS coordinator engineers of the generation companies was obtained on 5 December 2007, for the purpose of quality control of the performance of power stations
Automatic unit control system and display screens — PLC, DCS, SCADA, Logic & Analog .... etc
Operating desk panel and interface units
Availability of catalogues — "Service structure setting & Operating values & wiring diagrams"

Availability of the following: - Occupational safety and health instructions for unit operation and maintenance - Unit start-up and shutdown instructions - Instructions for operating the unified grid and manoeuvring with the National Energy Control Centre - Electrical drawings "S.L.D" and mechanical Flow Diagrams of the unit
Test, calibration and maintenance reports for the protection and metering devices in the unit control
- Operating programme on mixed fuel (mazout and gas)
- Availability of changeover from one fuel operating programme to an alternative fuel programme while the unit is in service
Unit running, alarm and automatic tripping lamps
Control centre panels for operating the unit auxiliaries
MCC of Units and numbering of components
Automatic alarm and automatic fire extinguishing system
- Cleanliness of the panels from inside and absence of dust
- Tight closing, cleanliness and labelling of the panel doors
Terminal devices transmitting unit data and status to the National Energy Control Centre — Remote Terminal Unit

General condition of the control room: - AC lighting - Emergency lighting (DC) - General cleanliness, availability of materials or devices for rodent control, and the condition of the furniture - Suitability and distribution of fire extinguishers in the room - Air conditioning and ventilation equipment in the room
Communication means available in the room: "telephone, wireless, carrier, microwave, mobile 000, etc."
